environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB configured as internet-facing with target group routing directly to pod port 8080. ALB listener on port 443 with ACM certificate for TLS termination. No authentication enforcement at the ALB layer. Ingress allows any HTTPS client. Logs shipped to CloudWatch via Fluent Bit sidecar with multi-line log parsing enabled. SIEM correlation rules trigger on specific log patterns for alerting.
